articles.title: Trezor says data breach affects another 67K US customers
articles.description: Trezor said an additional 67,000 US users were affected by its shipping provider’s data breach, opening the path to potential phishing attacks and social engineering scams.

articles.title: South Korean regulators introduce tokenized securities roadmap
articles.description: South Korea’s financial regulator introduced a three-phase roadmap for the issuance of tokenized assets, as the country prepares to adopt its first tokenized securities framework in February 2027.

articles.title: AMC chief criticizes Robinhood’s tokenized stock plan
articles.description: AMC’s CEO criticized Robinhood’s tokenized stock offerings for being unregulated in the US and said he will request an investigation from an external securities counsel.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $731M, highest since January as BTC reclaims $80K
articles.description: US Bitcoin ETFs drew $730.9 million on Thursday as Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000, though CryptoQuant flagged weak fresh demand and a key $83,000 test.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: El Salvador’s post-review Bitcoin accumulation used no public funds: IMF
articles.description: The IMF attributed Bitcoin added since June 2025 to private donations, addressing questions raised after El Salvador reported a $100 million acquisition.

articles.title: US, UK launch joint alliance targeting crypto scam centers
articles.description: The agreement includes parallel investigations and information sharing, with US and UK authorities planning a private-sector disruption operation in London in October.

articles.title: Tether sued over frozen ‘pig butcher’ coins, 6,600 students get crypto loans: Asia Express
articles.description: Thai businessmen sue Tether over $42M frozen USDT tied to pig butchering scam, Aussie crypto firms face big fines unless they meet licensing deadline.

articles.title: CFTC files to dismiss CME lawsuit over crypto perpetual futures
articles.description: The CFTC’s lawyers called the lawsuit “much ado about nothing,“ claiming that the CME Group lacked standing to file and argued against its claims over crypto perpetual futures.

articles.title: Mantle adds Paxos’ USDG stablecoin, joins Global Dollar Network
articles.description: Mantle has added Paxos-issued USDG as a natively minted stablecoin while joining the network’s reward-sharing structure.

articles.title: Michigan authorities continue pursuit to block Kalshi as Supreme Court fight looms
articles.description: Kalshi previously said it had been placed in an “impossible position” after federal authorities directed the company to ignore a Michigan restraining order issued in June.

articles.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80K as DXY falls amid continuing suspected yen intervention
articles.description: Bitcoin rallied 5% to reclaim $80,000 as the US dollar weakened amid a suspected Bank of Japan currency intervention, though analysts remain split on the impact.

articles.title: Bybit Pay integrates with Mesh to expand crypto payments
articles.description: The integration lets Bybit users spend digital assets directly from their exchange balances across Mesh-powered platforms.

articles.title: BitMEX co-founder contributed 75% of Reform UK’s donations in Q2 2026
articles.description: The UK political party and its leader, Nigel Farage, have accepted contributions from figures tied to the crypto industry, raising questions about potential influence on policies.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward partners with SoFi on stablecoin, 24/7 settlement
articles.description: The deal will bring SoFiUSD to Kraken, connect Payward to SoFi’s 24/7 dollar settlement network and give SoFi access to digital asset liquidity through Kraken Prime.

articles.title: Recovery specialists crack $1B crypto wallet... but find just $10
articles.description: Crypto recovery specialists reveal how lost wallets, passwords and seed phrases can sometimes be recovered — but that’s of no help if the money was never there in the first place.

articles.title: VARA, Securitize sign MoU for tokenization innovation in Dubai
articles.description: VARA and Securitize signed an MoU to foster more tokenization innovation in Dubai and explore how tokenized financial innovation should be regulated in the region.

articles.title: Nvidia buys Hugging Face for $12.9B in push into AI software
articles.description: Nvidia agreed to buy Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, gaining a platform used by more than 18 million developers to share and deploy AI models.

articles.title: Pencil Finance completes $1M onchain lending cycle for 6.6K students in Southeast Asia
articles.description: Pencil Finance said that its first-of-a-kind loan offered financing to 6,600 students in Southeast Asia who were underserved by traditional lenders.

articles.title: Standard Chartered launches spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in UAE
articles.description: Standard Chartered said it is the first major global bank to offer institutional access to spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE region.

articles.title: Coldcard hacker swaps stolen Bitcoin for ETH via THORChain
articles.description: The third-wave Coldcard exploiter moved about 10% of stolen funds through THORChain as researchers traced the assets to a new Ethereum address.

articles.title: Kalshi seeks CFTC approval for WTI crude perpetual futures: Report
articles.description: Kalshi reportedly plans to file for approval of a WTI crude oil perpetual futures contract that would trade around the clock five days a week without an expiration date.

articles.title: Australia warns unlicensed crypto firms of fines up to 10% of annual turnover
articles.description: ASIC has recorded more than 45 digital asset-related license applications as its temporary enforcement relief approaches Sept. 30 expiration.

articles.title: Ether, XRP ETF inflow streaks end as Bitcoin funds rebound
articles.description: Ether ETFs posted $48 million in outflows after attracting $1.62 billion over 12 trading days, while XRP funds ended an 11-session inflow run.

articles.title: Hyperscale Data ends Michigan BTC mining as holdings fall 79%
articles.description: Hyperscale Data’s Bitcoin holdings have fallen about 79% since late July to 215 BTC as it redirects capital toward its Michigan AI data center.

articles.title: US officials work with CrowdStrike to fight malware behind crypto theft
articles.description: Federal authorities and private-sector partners were part of an operation to disrupt malware that redirected about $150,000 in crypto over the last eight years.

articles.title: Coinbase launches regulated crypto derivatives in Canada
articles.description: Coinbase is offering eligible Canadian traders perpetual and dated futures with up to 10x leverage as major US trading platforms expand their crypto presence in Canada.

articles.title: New Jersey officials petition US Supreme Court over prediction markets
articles.description: New Jersey’s Attorney General and gaming authorities filed a petition for a writ of certiorari to the US Supreme Court over Kalshi offering sporting event contracts to residents.

articles.title: Wyoming adds Chainlink reserve verification to state-issued stable token
articles.description: Wyoming is using Chainlink to bring near-real-time reserve verification onchain for FRNT as the oracle provider expands its footprint across tokenized financial markets.

articles.title: Ondo urges SEC, CFTC to bring US stock perpetuals onshore
articles.description: Ondo says existing US securities laws can accommodate perpetual futures tied to individual stocks as regulators look to bring more derivatives activity onshore.
